test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**access**" means the ability or right to approach, enter, or use something. (प्रवेश या उपयोग की अनुमति)
 
• In the context of the passage, "access to safe drinking water" is the correct phrasing, indicating the ability for people to obtain safe drinking water.
 
• The other options: "**entrance**," "**accession**," and "**providence**" do not fit the context as appropriately. "Entrance" refers to a place of entry; "accession" refers to the attainment of a position of rank or power; and "providence" means divine guidance or care, none of which are suitable in this context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *These deaths can be prevented if people have access__ to safe drinking water.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Entrance (प्रवेश)**: means a place or point of entering. It does not convey the sense of having the ability to use something.
 
• **Accession (अधिकार प्राप्त करना)**: means the attainment of a rank or power. This term is not appropriate for the context of obtaining water.
 
• **Providence (देखरेख या संरक्षण)**: means divine guidance or care. This term does not fit in the context of practical access to a resource.

36:T9e2,

The correct answer is “ **Division “.**
